name: The Time Killer
source:
Fah, Erick, and Nicholas went on a road trip, little did they know that someone was about to make it the worst trip of their lives.

[From [url=https://neatneet.itch.io/the-time-killer]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
法、埃里克与尼古拉斯三人结伴踏上公路旅行，却浑然不知某个人即将把这趟旅途变成他们一生中最可怕的噩梦。

[摘自[url=https://neatneet.itch.io/the-time-killer]itch.io[/url]]
